_comment: Verbatim output of `aws ec2 describe-instance-types --region us-east-1
Archived because the write-up asserts the vCPU count, host RAM, host CPU
architecture and the nominal GPU memory, and AWS is the authority for all four.
Note TotalGpuMemoryInMiB 16384 is the NOMINAL figure; nvidia-smi on the running
instance reports 15360 (see gpu_probe.txt). Both appear in the article.
Note also Manufacturer reads 'AWS', not 'Graviton2' -- the generation is not in
this API. 2.5 GHz aarch64 is consistent with Graviton2, which HARDWARE.md records.
_summary: g5g.2xlarge: 8 vCPU, 16 GiB host RAM, arm64 at 2.5 GHz, 1x NVIDIA T4g, 16384 MiB nominal GPU memory.
